items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: they recorded the She's Crying For Me blues, which Santo put together, Santo Picor

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, they rehearsed the tunes, and they call it the Golden Leaf Stretch, which is the Millen Boy can see, and in those days, Bill, I guess you know it, the boys used to smoke the marijuana, and it used to be wrapped in the yellow paper, so they called it the Golden Leaf Strut. And then they recorded the She's Crying For Me blues, which Santo put together, Santo Picor, and they also never knew what a gal could do, and I forget the other tune. Yeah, some pop-sounding tune.

Sounds like a late pop tune almost. Well, I think that about covers everything. Maybe later, if we think of some more things, another day we can come and talk another half hour if you think of everything. All right, Bill. I certainly appreciate you taking time off from your business.
